svg.title: MERIDIAN — The Last Frontier
svg.desc: Editorial artwork of a desert at dusk: a glowing circular Gate stands on the horizon between floating basalt monoliths above layered dunes, with the wordmark MERIDIAN and the subtitle THE LAST FRONTIER.

text.font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond','Iowan Old Style','Palatino Linotype',Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif
'Cormorant Garamond','Iowan Old Style','Palatino Linotype',Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif

svg.text: Beyond the last road, stone floats and the sun never fully sets.
